business_problem: One technology people expect to see everywhere in the near future is automated driving systems in automobiles. As these systems grow in sophistication, we can expect them to spawn all kinds of solutions to social problems. They can be expected to solve the shortage of drivers, for example, prevent traffic accidents, and give rise to new ways of passing the time during journeys (“secondary activities”).
solution_summary: Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation built this solution on Azure AI Studio, Azure Machine Learning. One technology people expect to see everywhere in the near future is automated driving systems in automobiles. As these systems grow in sophistication, we can expect them to spawn all kinds of solutions to social problems. Azure AI Studio supports building, testing, and validating AI workflows and prompts for the solution. Azure Machine Learning supports model training, evaluation, and deployment for machine learning workloads. AVOps streamlines data ingestion, annotation and machine learning workflows, accelerating the development of sensor fusion systems and improving recognition performance. An image scene analyzing system using Azure AI Studio is now being validated.
